notes:
Safer saving and smoother boards. Underneath is now on Windows too: getunderneath.com/beta.

Fixed: If a save fails, closing the tab no longer loses your words: the tab stays open until it saves
Fixed: A script changed outside Underneath just before you save is always kept as a copy
Fixed: Replace All with an empty Find box no longer changes your script
Fixed: Boards and outlines pan and zoom more smoothly, and dragging cards on boards with many links no longer stutters
Fixed: One scroll step with ⌘ zooms by a small step; the middle mouse button pans
Fixed: Zoom to fit shows every card, and the zoom slider matches the zoom
Fixed: Sticky notes keep their place after you move a note
Fixed: Document Settings remembers when you turn off “Dialogue, bottom of page”
Changed: The beta licence spells out how testers earn a free Underneath 1 licence
